summary: Graviton (ARM) CPU inference routing is implemented for pytorch and tensorflow on c6g, t4g, r6g, and m6g. Changes: fw_utils.py adds GRAVITON_ALLOWED_TARGET_INSTANCE_FAMILY and GRAVITON_ALLOWED_FRAMEWORKS; image_uris.py adds _resolve_image_scope (runs before config loading) and the -sagemaker suffix rule for *-inference-graviton repos; pytorch.json and tensorflow.json each gain one inference_graviton section (pure insertions); tests add test_graviton.py (test_graviton_pytorch, test_graviton_tensorflow, both passing), graviton_framework_uri in expected_uris.py, and two version fixtures in tests/conftest.py. Verification: tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris ran 663 passed with 2 collection errors (test_retrieve.py and jumpstart) because the shared venv lacks the mock package, so those suites are unverified. test_fw_utils.py and test_pytorch.py were not run for the same reason. Tests must be run with PYTHONPATH set to the working copy src, since the venv's sagemaker points at base/. Spot checks of the spec behaviors all match. Nothing is committed.
